datasheet.title: MCP23017/MCP23S17 16-Bit I/O Expander with Serial Interface

description: 16-bit I/O expander with SPI serial interface.

socket.placement: SOIC pin 1 aligned with ZIF pin 1 at the top/pin-1 end of the socket

pin_voltage_limit_notes: pins[*].vmin and pins[*].vmax are numeric operating values used for project generation.
MCP23S17 signal pins use the maximum operating supply level of 5.5 V as vmax.
VDD uses the specified operating range 1.8 V to 5.5 V; VSS is 0 V.
Absolute-maximum voltage ratings are retained separately under absolute_maximum_ratings.
